_about: Dustfall: the gun, the raiders by kind, charges, breaches, the works on the grid, the colony phase and the turn chimes. Everything is placed on the grid in play, so one-shots render mono.

sounds._about: The title: a slow minor sway under a marimba line, with wind under it all.
The pause: the pad and a few kalimba notes, slower still.
Night held: a rising harp figure that settles.
Relief lands: horns turn the minor sway major.
The dome falls: a cello line sinking under rumble.
A drifter's step: a soft falling whoosh.
A skitter's step: two quick ticks.
A hulk's step: a heavy tread with a low rumble.
A sapper's step: a ratchet of gears.
A mule's step: a chugging little engine.
The mothership: a deep pulsing drone.
The carrier: a deeper rumble that shakes the floor.
A raider arrives: a radar ping.
A raider leaves over the edge: a long falling whoosh.
The gun slides: a scrape along the rail.
The gun fires: a falling laser.
A hit rings on the raider.
A raider down: a small burst.
A missile: a rising rush, then the burst.
A raider charging: a rising whine under its column.
A shot dodged: the bolt passing.
A shot lands: a zap on the shield or dome.
A breach on the shield: a crackle of discharge.
A breach on the dome: a blast and a rumble.
A building goes dark: a falling run of notes.
A wall is bashed: a crack and a shower of grit.
A wall falls: a slide of rubble.
A mine goes off.
A flak post fires: three quick bursts.
The dust storm's wind, looped at the column it covers: a low gritty gust with a slow swell.
Bought: a bright two-note rise.
Too dear: a low buzz.
Ready for the night: a soft two-tone alarm.
The scan and the placing cursor: a blip where the sector is.
Your turn: a rising confirm.
Turn over: two falling beeps.
Menu move: a dry radio click.
Menu select: a soft sonar ping.
Menu back: a lower, shorter ping.
